**Working Notes**

**Form**: Version 1. Required fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country (6 total).

**Critical problem**: Every submission has been rejected (0 accepted across 10 attempts). The JSON payloads consistently show only 3 of 6 fields (cust, email, order_date). The missing fields — priority, qty, ship_country — are almost certainly the cause of the "2 field(s) invalid" rejections. Source records are also truncated mid-text, so full data may not be available.

**Attempt rule**: 3 attempts per customer, then auto-routes to manual review.

**Observed customers**:
- Eli Okafor / user198@example.com / 2026-10-13
- Bo Reyes / user831@example.com / 2026-03-25
- Cy Okafor / user281@example.com / 2026-07-08
- Dee Okafor / user710@example.com / 2026-06-07

**Date caveat**: One Cy Okafor attempt used 2025-07-08 (wrong year) and received 3 invalid fields vs. the usual 2 — the year error likely cascaded or added a validation failure. Stick to 2026 unless source clearly says otherwise.

**Action items for next batch**:
1. Check whether priority, qty, ship_country values are present anywhere in the source record before submitting. If absent, the submission will fail.
2. If data is genuinely missing, flag for manual review rather than burning all 3 attempts.
3. Verify order_date year against context (all current orders are 2026).
4. Front-desk names appear unreliable/mangled — do not use them for identity matching.
